newsitem.title: USA: Elbit to sell Fibronics assets to MRV.
newsitem.headline: Elbit to sell Fibronics assets to MRV.

text.p: Elbit Ltd said on Thursday that it agreed to sell the majority of the assets of its Fibronics Ltd subsidiary for $22.8 million.
The manufacturer of computerized systems said in a statement that it would sell the assets to MRV Communications, and that the purchase price included $10.5 million in MRV common stock.
Elbit said the transaction was not expected to have a material effect on its quarterly financial results.
Elbit said its board of directors approved the sale of the majority of the assets of Fibronics and the unit's subisidiaries in Israel and worldwide.
Elbit would retain the shares of Fibronics companies and their liabilities, and it would also retain the rights to use certain technology developed by Fibronics, it said.
Fibronics provides enterprise and workgroup network solutions.
California-based MRV makes LAN connectivity solutions and digital linear fiber optic transmission products.
